title.zh: 60 次交旗的单挑：Player5 31:29 逆转 Opus 5.5
title.en: A 60-capture duel: Player5 comes back to beat Opus 5.5 31–29

desc.zh: 平均每 6.7 回合一次交旗。Opus 5.5 中盘长时间领先，第 295 回合领先 4 分；Player5 第 378 回合反超后再未落后。
desc.en: A capture every 6.7 turns on average. Opus 5.5 led through the middle game and was 4 up on turn 295; Player5 went ahead on turn 378 and stayed there.
